newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil telecom rate hike seen spurring competition.
newsitem.headline: Brazil telecom rate hike seen spurring competition.

text.p: Brazil's new telecommunications tariffs are intended to reduce cross-subsidies in the sector and stimulate competition, a senior communications ministry official said on Thursday.
"We are doing this to allow competition in services which are currently subsidized," Renato Guerreiro, the ministry's executive secretary, said.

Earlier, the ministry announced tariff changes that would lead to an average increase of 8.3 percent for subscribers and an increase of 3.1 percent in revenues for the federal Telebras communications system.
